_comment: The self-test used to run against the PRODUCTION standard, which meant a 3-card
fixture catalog was measured against a format baseline naming 21 real cards. That
was invisible until the baseline-existence check landed on 2026-08-15 and reported
all 21 as stale. Beyond that one break, it coupled the self-test to a file that
changes whenever a card is rewritten -- the fixtures are supposed to pin the RULES,
Kept deliberately plain: an EMPTY format baseline so every rule is enforced on the
fixture cards, no banned phrases (bannedPhrases has its own fixture path if one is
ever added), and no derivedFiles, because the renderer and prompt cross-checks
resolve paths relative to the config under test and there is no page under Tools/.
